descriptions.zh: 本文介绍通过出海版搜索-GlobalSearch的使用方法以及参数说明
descriptions.en: This document describes the usage and parameter specifications of GlobalSearch, the global edition of IQS Search.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iqs global-search --query '特朗普最新关税消息' --time-range OneWeek --page 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2024-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iqs GET /linked-retrieval/linked-retrieval-entry/v1/iqs/search/global --region cn-hangzhou --query '特朗普最新关税消息' --pageSize 10 --page 1 --timeRange OneWeek --header "Content-Type=application/json"
